description: This file generates and displays a list view for a module in the vtiger CRM system, handling permissions, custom views, sorting, searching, pagination, and rendering the list with Smarty templates.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view configurations and permissions for the current module.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: Builds SQL queries for listing records based on current view and search conditions.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Manages the generation of list view headers, entries, and search fields.

methods.name: initSortbyField
methods.description: Initializes the default sort field for the module.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the current field used for sorting.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the current custom view.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates HTML for the custom view selection dropdown.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Retrieves details of a custom view by its ID.

methods.name: isPermittedChangeStatus
methods.description: Checks if the user can change the status of a custom view.

methods.name: isPermittedCustomView
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to perform actions on a custom view.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query for listing records.

methods.name: getConditionalWhere
methods.description: Returns the WHERE clause conditions for the current query.

methods.name: addUserSearchConditions
methods.description: Adds search conditions based on user input.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Generates the header for the list view table.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the list of records to display.

methods.name: getBasicSearchFieldInfoList
methods.description: Provides information for basic search fields.
